## Summary

Describe the problem, the chosen change, and its scientific or operational impact.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant Python tests.
- [ ] I validated changed shell files with `bash -n`.
- [ ] I clean-built every affected model variant.
- [ ] I documented any test not run and why.

## Provenance And Results

- [ ] I did not edit the upstream RLINE snapshot directly.
- [ ] Any upstream correction is a small, reviewable patch with a test.
- [ ] Ordinary generated results and golden files are unchanged.
- [ ] Any intentional golden-file update is isolated, justified, and includes reproduction metadata.
- [ ] I identified whether reported outputs are regulatory, reference, or experimental.
